## Shipping & Payment Policies (Pakistan)

- **Delivery Method:** Standard Nationwide Courier Delivery (TCS Express & Leopards Courier) — 2–4 Business Days across all cities in Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, and nationwide).
- **Delivery Charges:** Flat ₨ 400 nationwide.
- **Free Delivery:** Automatic Free Nationwide Delivery on orders above ₨ 3,000.
- **Payment Methods:** Cash on Delivery (COD) nationwide, plus Online Mobile Wallet Payments (Easypaisa, JazzCash, and NayaPay) with instant receipt verification.
